features.apple: Card > Look for Duplicates, Merge Selected Cards; ABDuplicateReviewSheet.nib
features.note: Card > Merge Duplicates merges the open card with its twins (dupes.rs merge). dupes::review lists the fields where duplicates disagree and dupes::merge_with folds the cards with the value picked for each field; no review sheet is drawn yet, and group membership of merged cards is dropped.
features.wire: Draw the review sheet over dupes::review, fold with dupes::merge_with after the person picks, and keep the merged card's group membership.

features.apple: Card > Open in Separate Window; ABContactCardWindowController.nib
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/main.rs:71 (open_card_window, Ctx::open_window); main.rs:286 (draw_window); main.rs:296 (window_event); main.rs:315 (window_closed); springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs:864 (draw_card); contacts.rs:888 (touch_card: scroll, tap copies, Edit); contacts.rs:942 (edit_from_card); contacts.rs:1957 (Card > Open in Separate Window); contacts.rs:3053 (double-click on a row); springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/card_windows.rs (CardWindows); springboard/sdk/src/app_windows.rs
features.note: Works end to end on the desk: the shell opens a window per card (ExternalWindow), the app draws the card at its size and takes touches in it. A tap on an email opens Mail with the address (mail_compose) and a tap on a phone opens a tel: link (see Card phone and email links). Differences from Apple: the Edit button shows the contact and opens its editor in the main window but cannot raise that window (the SDK has no focus call for the main window). Not verified on Midget or on the host.
features.wire: Check on Midget: open a card from Card > Open in Separate Window and by double-click, scroll it, tap an email or phone, press Edit. Add a focus call so Edit raises the main window.
